IBY.name: Ibn Battuta
IBY.look: a young Moroccan man of about twenty-one with warm light-brown skin, a short neat dark beard and kind, curious eyes, in a cream hooded wool travelling cloak over a long white tunic, a white turban and a leather bag across his chest

IB.name: Ibn Battuta
IB.look: a Moroccan man of about forty-five with warm light-brown skin and a full dark beard touched with grey, kind, curious eyes, in a cream hooded wool travelling cloak over a long white tunic, a white turban and a leather bag across his chest
